# authwise_factor (Data Source)

A second step a realm offers, such as TOTP, WebAuthn or Duo. `config` comes from the matching config data source; disabling keeps enrolled authenticators, destroying does not. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `factor_type` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `realm_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
